Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Data and Analytics.

Business: CTO Data Technology

Job ID: 59152

Principal Responsibilities

  • Build end-to-end agents for defined workflows across:
  • KYC onboarding: case triage, document checklist guidance, entity/UBO summarisation, exception routing support.
  • Credit assessment: application/financial summary extraction, covenant tracking support, credit memo drafting assistance, rationale tracing to evidence.
  • Portfolio management: exposure overview, concentration monitoring support, event/news summarisation, portfolio review pack assistance.
  • Implement RAG with strong grounding: ingestion, chunking, indexing, reranking, citations, freshness strategies and access controls.
  • Integrate agents with internal services/APIs and workflow tools (case management, knowledge bases, data services).
  • Engineer predictable behaviour: structured outputs, guardrails, refusal/fallback patterns, and robust error handling.
  • Build evaluation and regression testing (golden sets, quality/safety metrics, telemetry and feedback loops).
  • Ensure operational readiness: monitoring, alerting, audit logs, incident response runbooks, and cost/latency optimisation.
  • Collaborate with Risk/Compliance/InfoSec to meet control expectations for sensitive KYC and credit information.

Requirements

  • Delivering agents that materially reduce manual effort and cycle time in onboarding and credit workflows.
  • Producing grounded, explainable outputs with traceable citations to approved documents/data.
  • Achieving stable production operations (SLA adherence, low incident rates, clear runbooks).
  • Establishing reusable agent patterns (RAG templates, evaluation harnesses, guardrails) across squads.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Consultant Specialist.

Business: Asia & Middle East Technology

Job ID: 52390

Principal Responsibilities

Full Stack Delivery

  • Own the delivery lifecycle: requirement clarification, solution design, development, testing and production release (front-end + back-end).
  • Design and build scalable, highly available backend services and APIs using Java (e.g., Spring Boot) with REST and/or GraphQL.
  • Build and improve front-end experiences using modern frameworks (React/Angular/Vue), promoting reusable components and engineering best practices.

AI/LLM Enablement

  • Integrate LLM capabilities into business workflows (enterprise Q&A, RAG, summarisation, classification/extraction, etc.).
  • Contribute to designing and implementing RAG architectures: vector search, embeddings, reranking, permission trimming, caching/fallback, and prompt management.
  • Establish engineering practices for AI features: evaluation metrics, offline/online testing, observability (quality/latency/cost), and A/B experiments.
  • Partner with Security/Compliance to implement data protection and output safety controls (PII handling, prompt injection mitigation, access control).

AWS Engineering & Reliability

  • Build and operate services on AWS (e.g., containerisation, auto-scaling, deployment and rollback).
  • Drive CI/CD, automated testing (unit/integration/E2E), logging/metrics/tracing and alerting.
  • Support incident troubleshooting, root-cause analysis (RCA), and continuous improvement to strengthen reliability and delivery efficiency.

Senior-Level Impact

  • Act as a technical owner in cross-team delivery: break down work, manage risks, and drive outcomes.
  • Mentor engineers through code reviews, pairing and knowledge sharing.

Requirements

  • Solid full stack engineering experience delivering complex features end-to-end.
  • Backend: strong Java skills; experience with Spring Boot / Spring ecosystem; sound API design and service governance.
  • Frontend: experience with at least one modern framework (React/Angular/Vue); ability to write maintainable, testable code.
  • Data: good knowledge of relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL/Oracle) and SQL; familiarity with caching (e.g., Redis) is a plus.
  • Engineering practices: Git, code reviews, testing strategy, CI/CD; strong awareness of secure coding (e.g., OWASP Top 10).
  • AI foundations: understanding of LLM application patterns (Prompt/RAG/Tool calling) and ability to integrate and evaluate AI features.

/WX

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Assistant Business Manager II.

Business: Asia & Middle East Technology

Job ID：55627

Principal Responsibilities

  • Support third party onboarding, renewal, change, and exit activities.
  • Coordinate due diligence reviews across risk, compliance, legal, procurement, information security, privacy, resilience, and finance teams.
  • Maintain accurate records of third party engagements, contracts, risk assessments, approvals, issues, and remediation actions.
  • Track vendor risk ratings, service criticality, outsourcing classification, and required control evidence.
  • Follow up with business owners and vendors on missing documentation, overdue actions, and review outcomes.
  • Support periodic third party performance reviews, risk reassessments, and contract governance meetings.
  • Monitor third party obligations, service levels, audit findings, incidents, and risk events.
  • Assist with reporting on third party inventory, overdue reviews, open issues, high-risk vendors, and governance exceptions.
  • Ensure third party engagement processes comply with internal policies, standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Escalate material risks, overdue remediation, policy breaches, or incomplete approvals to management.
  • Contribute to process improvement, control enhancement, and standardization of third party management procedures.
  • Support internal audits, regulatory requests, and management reviews related to third party governance.

Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications

  • Minimum 2 years’ relevant experience, preferably with banking or financial institutions experience, in risk management (technology risk and third party risk), compliance or audit area
  • Basic understanding of third party risk management, vendor governance, procurement, outsourcing, or operational risk.
  • Familiarity with risk assessment, control testing, audit evidence, issue tracking, and remediation follow-up.
  • Awareness of contract lifecycle concepts, service level management, and vendor performance monitoring.
  • Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders such as business teams, procurement, legal, compliance, cyber security, data privacy, and finance.
  • Experience maintaining trackers, dashboards, registers, or workflow records.
  • Financial services, technology, operations, or regulated-industry experience is preferred.
  • Experience in IT Procurement and project management would be advantageous
  • With knowledge of risk management, controls and processes is Preferred
  • Persistent, resilient, flexible and resourceful. Comfortable working in an agile, complex and dynamic environment
  • Good interpersonal communication and stakeholder management skills across all levels of management
  • A strong team player with can-do attitude and ability to balance working independently with limited supervision between working together as a team
  • Good analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Clear written and verbal communication in English and Chinese

/WX/LP

We develop, implement and support software and IT services and processes that allow HSBC to remain at the forefront of high-quality banking systems.

ln:4470697105.descriptionHtml:
CIB - Corporate Banking

HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Corporate Banking provides international financial services solutions that support businesses ranging from mid-market enterprises to large corporates across industries and sectors. Leveraging the strength, scope, and expertise of our global product network, Corporate Banking is positioned as an essential partner to firms seeking to maximise their potential internationally, offering streamlined business access to HSBC’s international network and broad range of market leading banking products and services.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Contribute to Global Markets sales revenue generation, return targets set by business performance and objectives
  • Identify sales opportunities that address specific needs for our clients and managing from identification to point of sale and through post trade process
  • Service a portfolio of Strategic and/or Focus clients, including Transactional clients where required
  • Manage and develop relationships with transactional clients, including those serviced over e-platforms for flow based business.
  • Provide day to day sales coverage using the full suite of Corporate Sales offerings and support team members to do the same
  • Deliver services and solutions that meet client needs and where necessary leverage the bank’s depth of product expertise and Thought Leadership
  • Develop trusted relationships with clients to drive revenue growth and greater product penetration

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Bachelor's or equivalent University degree, minimum 10 years' relevant experience as a Global Markets corporate sales
  • Well versed with Global Markets and relevant Global Markets products, local regulations, regulatory requirements, market practices and business trends
  • Experienced in handling and dealing with local commercial banking or corporate clients in East China will be preferred
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills both in Chinese and English with very strong people interaction ability
  • Strong interpersonal skills, open minded, be able to present best-fit solutions for client needs
  • Ability to explore business network, acquire and on-board new client names
  • Strong sense of operational risk management and ability to adhere to the Bank's operational risk requirements
  • Attention to detail and ability to ensure that transactions, business information is captured in a timely and highly accurate manner
  • Able to work independently with limited supervision, proactive and willing to run job duties under pressure against multiple deadlines
  • Business Travels will be required

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

Principal Responsibilities
- Design, develop, test and maintain production-grade software and AI-enabled applications.
- Translate lending business requirements and operational challenges into practical technology solutions.
- Work with AI engineers, software engineers, architects, product owners, data specialists and lending subject-matter experts.
- Develop reliable APIs, services, data pipelines and application components.
- Support the integration of machine learning and generative AI capabilities into lending platforms, subject to appropriate risk, security and governance controls.
- Apply software engineering best practices, including clean code, automated testing, version control, continuous integration and continuous delivery.
- Contribute to the full software development lifecycle, from discovery and design through implementation, deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement.
- Ensure solutions meet applicable standards for resilience, security, privacy, model risk management and regulatory compliance.
- Investigate incidents, identify root causes and implement sustainable fixes.
- Document technical designs, operational procedures and key decisions.
- Share knowledge across locations and contribute to a collaborative engineering culture.
- Support the responsible adoption of AI by considering explainability, human oversight, data quality, bias, security and appropriate use of outputs.
Requirements
- Experience as a software engineer, developer or technology professional within WPS Lending or a closely related lending technology environment.
- Good understanding of lending products, processes, platforms or customer journeys.
- Strong programming experience in Java and/or Python.
- Experience building and supporting production applications, services or APIs.
- Understanding of software engineering principles, including:
-
- Object-oriented design
- Automated testing
- Version control
- CI/CD
- Secure coding
- Observability and monitoring
- Experience working with relational or non-relational databases and data-oriented applications.
- Ability to analyse complex problems and communicate solutions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Experience working effectively in distributed, cross-location teams.
- Willingness to learn and apply AI engineering practices, including model and prompt evaluation, retrieval-augmented generation, orchestration, monitoring and responsible AI controls.
Desirable experience
- Experience delivering AI, machine learning, generative AI or automation solutions.
- Familiarity with cloud platforms and containerised applications, such as Docker and Kubernetes.
- Experience with event-driven architectures, microservices or distributed systems.
- Knowledge of lending decisioning, credit processes, servicing, collections, risk or customer onboarding.
- Experience with data engineering, data quality, feature engineering or model integration.
- Familiarity with MLOps, LLMOps, model monitoring or AI application evaluation.
- Experience working in a regulated financial services environment.
- Practical understanding of secure development, identity and access management, encryption and data protection.
***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited Xian Branch***

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist.

Business: GTS Technology

Req ID: 62746

Location: Xi'an

The Opportunity

Design, automate and operate secure, resilient technology platforms that enable development teams to deliver software quickly and reliably. DevOps combines software development and IT operations, with strong emphasis on collaboration, automation and continuous delivery.

Principal Responsibilities

  • Manage cloud and on-premises platforms, containers and orchestration tools.
  • Monitor system performance, availability, capacity and security.
  • Support incident, problem and change management.
  • Improve reliability, recoverability and operational resilience.
  • Work with developers, architects, testers, cyber-security and operations teams.
  • Apply infrastructure-as-code and configuration-management practices.

Knowledge & Experience / Qualifications

  • Understanding of Agile delivery, secure development and IT service management.
  • Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Works effectively across engineering, business and control functions.
  • Communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical colleagues.
  • Looks for practical improvements rather than simply maintaining the status quo.
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms, commonly Azure, AWS or Google Cloud.

What Additional Skills Will Be Good To Have？

  • Experience in DevOps, site reliability engineering, platform engineering or software engineering.
  • Knowledge of monitoring and observability tools.

You’ll achieve more at HSBC

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

Job Summary

This role could be based in Malaysia or China. When you start the application process you will be presented with a drop-down menu showing all countries, please ensure that you only select a country where the role is based

  • Own the discovery, definition and delivery of change for the Wealth Management Core Platform, with primary focus on the Unit Trust System (UTS) and its upstream and downstream integrations.
  • Translate business, operational and regulatory needs into clear product requirements, change requests, user stories, acceptance criteria and delivery priorities.
  • Act as the accountable bridge between country business teams, operations, technology chapters, external vendors and dependent platforms throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  • Drive outcomes from requirement clarification and solution assessment through design sign-off, testing, release readiness, production deployment and post-release monitoring.

Key Responsibilities

Product Ownership and Delivery

  • Own and maintain the product backlog, ensuring initiatives, epics, features, user stories and acceptance criteria are clear, prioritised and traceable to business outcomes.
  • Lead requirement discovery and validation with Product, Operations and country stakeholders; identify gaps, challenge assumptions and establish an agreed scope and baseline.
  • Prepare and manage change requests, review vendor responses and functional specifications, resolve open questions, secure stakeholder approvals and provide formal sign-off when requirements are satisfied.
  • Coordinate with engineering, architecture, quality assurance, production engineering, vendors and dependent application teams to assess solutions, manage dependencies and maintain delivery momentum.
  • Plan and support SIT, UAT and business validation; track evidence and defects, secure sign-off, assess release readiness and support deployment and post-production monitoring.
  • Manage delivery risks, scope, priorities, milestones and regulatory deadlines; communicate decisions, trade-offs, dependencies and escalation needs clearly to stakeholders and senior management.
  • Build sufficient functional and technical understanding of UTS, interfaces, data mappings, reports and operational processes to facilitate effective solution discussions and make informed product decisions.
  • Maintain clear delivery documentation and governance records in the agreed collaboration and work-management tools, and drive continuous improvement in product and delivery practices.

Skills And Experience

Must-have Skills

  • Product Ownership and Backlog Management
  • Requirements Analysis and User Story Definition
  • Stakeholder, Vendor and Dependency Management
  • Agile Delivery, Testing and Release Governance

Other Skills

  • Wealth Management Products and Operations
  • Application Interfaces, Data Mapping and Reporting
  • Risk, Regulatory and Controls Awareness
  • Written and Verbal Communication
  • SQL, Python, shell scripting and basic programming (advantageous)
  • Automation through AI

Motivations

  • Motivated by turning complex business and regulatory needs into practical platform outcomes that improve customer and operational experience.
  • Energised by collaborating across business, operations, technology and vendor teams to resolve ambiguity and deliver shared outcomes.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, multi-market environment requiring structured analysis, prioritisation, sound judgement and disciplined follow-through.
  • Driven by learning platform functionality and technical flows deeply enough to challenge solutions constructively and make informed product decisions.
  • Demonstrates resilience and ownership when managing competing priorities, delivery dependencies, regulatory deadlines and production risks.

Qualifications

Key Experiences

  • Experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst or equivalent role delivering complex application changes in financial services.
  • Demonstrated experience gathering requirements, writing change requests or user stories, reviewing functional designs and securing stakeholder sign-off.
  • Experience coordinating vendors and cross-functional technology teams through testing, release and production implementation.
  • Knowledge of system integration patterns and experience defining clear integration specifications for upstream and downstream systems.
  • Proven ability to resolve ambiguity, evaluate trade-offs and lead stakeholder discussions towards agreed decisions and successful outcomes.
  • Demonstrates learning agility, self-motivation and resourcefulness by quickly building domain knowledge, proactively closing knowledge gaps, and making effective use of available people, information and tools to drive outcomes.
  • Working knowledge of wealth management, investment products, order management, client communications or regulatory reporting is highly preferred.

Certifications/Qualifications

  • No mandatory certification. Relevant degree or equivalent practical experience required; Agile or Product Owner certification is advantageous.

Languages

  • Full proficiency English & Mandarin to support business needs in specific market.

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

ln:4479816732.descriptionHtml:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

Role Overview

The Mission of the role is to lead the transformation of our digital products, evolving them into Data-Driven and AI-enabled digital channel experiences.

In This Role, You Will

  • End-to-End product ownership: Own the full lifecycle of assigned digital products, ensuring the digital experience are intuitive, easy-to-use, robust, and fulfill business purpose.
  • Strategic Alignment: Ensure digital capabilities and journeys to align with IWPB Omni Channel Strategy and Wealth Transformation strategy.
  • Agile Evolution & Commercial Value: Lead the continuous evolution of the digital capabilities and journeys through a "test and learn" approach, delivering commercially successful outcomes and measurable ROI.
  • Market Intelligence & Strategy: Maintain a deep understanding of customer & frontline pain points, wealth management market trends, and emerging AI/tech capabilities to define a forward-looking digital product strategy
  • Capability Enhancement: Identify and drive improvement opportunities that enhance customer and frontline experiences.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Distribution, Proposition and Technology teams to develop/enhance digital capabilities, ensuring they meet the evolving needs of the customers and business.
  • Culture & Leadership: Act as a catalyst for a customer-centric and simplification culture.
  • External Benchmarking: Proactively engage with external partners and industry bodies to monitor market trends, adapting the digital product roadmap to stay ahead of the curve.
  • Risk Management: Proactively identify and manage key risks, issues, and interdependencies, applying robust mitigation to protect the bank and the brand.

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Digital Transformation Track Record: Proven experience delivering digital transformation with tangible business outcomes within financial services
  • Agile & Design Thinking: Extensive experience with User-Centered Design, rapid prototyping, and delivering products within an Agile environment.
  • Full Product Lifecycle: Demonstrated expertise in opportunity identification, business case creation, requirements definition, cross-functional deployment, project execution, launch, and post-launch performance management.
  • Tech Fluency: Strong technical aptitude with the ability to translate business and frontline needs into precise IT and AI requirements.
  • Platform Versatility: Exposure to diverse technical landscapes, including digital front-ends, internal user facing systems, and various backend systems to ensure seamless integration for target journeys.
  • Strategic Thought Leadership: Creative and proactive in proposing new business opportunities and solving complex customer or operational challenges.
  • Project Management: Competent in project planning, reporting, and managing shifting or competing priorities with flexibility.
  • Stakeholder Influence: Proven ability to build strong relationships and influence large, cross-functional teams, including those with direct leadership authority.
  • Decision Making: Capable of sharing responsibility for key decisions while driving internal decision-making processes to a conclusion.
  • Analytical Rigor: Strong analytical and presentation skills to drive data-backed decisions.
  • Attitude: Energetic, positive, and a collaborative team player.
  • Flexibility: A flexible approach to work, adaptable to changing business hours and priorities.
  • Language: Fluent in English is a plus
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent is preferable.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited
